category_descriptions.ambiguous_record_scope: One or more linked textbook records require expert judgment before assignment, usually because the record scope, direction, or skill does not map cleanly to an AO.
category_descriptions.ao_no_evidence: One or more atomic objectives have no accepted textbook records in this row.
category_descriptions.candidate_new_atomic_objective: One or more inspected textbook records teach a measurable skill that does not directly match the current atomic objectives and should be reviewed as a candidate AO proposal.
category_descriptions.no_reused_assessment: One or more atomic objectives cannot reuse a source exercise_item as an assessment.
category_descriptions.corpus_gap: The linked textbook corpus has no records for this subtopic.
category_descriptions.curriculum_textbook_mismatch: The curriculum AO scope and the linked textbook record scope diverge.
category_descriptions.prerequisite_only_evidence: The textbook includes prerequisite or foundation content, but that content does not directly satisfy the atomic objective.
